relations: Falling water striking the basin continuously reshapes the white curtain and generates a billowing plume of mist and splash.
The foreground stream rushing over exposed brown boulders squeezes between them, forming tumbling white rapids that flow toward the viewer.
Foam crests and reforms as the current washes over stones, while subtle ripples shift reflections on the turquoise pool surface.
A fixed viewpoint highlights the continuous, ever-changing motion of water cascading and flowing through the rocky, moss-dressed landscape.
caption: The video showcases a mountain waterfall cascading from a rocky ledge into a vivid turquoise pool, framed by steep grey cliffs dressed in green moss, grass and conifers. The white curtain of falling water churns continuously, its shape and spray reshaping from moment to moment as it strikes the basin below. At the foot of the falls, a frothy plume of mist and splash billows and settles in restless, ever-changing patterns. The brown stones in the stream stay exposed as the current washes over and around them. In the foreground, a fast stream rushes over rounded brown boulders, generating tumbling white rapids that flow toward the viewer. The foam crests and reforms as the current squeezes between the rocks. Meanwhile, the pool surface carries subtle ripples and shifting reflections. The viewpoint appears broadly fixed, so the most evident motion is the water flowing through the scene.
